Info

            
Laundry, without the guessing. A cross-platform app that connects custom Arduino sensors to Firebase, turning laundry machine motion into real-time status updates. Push notifications, floor-based navigation, lost-item reporting, and an AI chat assistant make a shared laundry room easier to navigate.

            
Stack: React Native, TypeScript, Firebase, OpenAI API
Hardware: Arduino, IoT motion sensors, Firebase Realtime Database
